searchText: hey! happy new year! hope all is well wherever you are. i've been thinking about the way everything ended and it doesn't feel right to me. it's not who i am to just abandon someone without an explanation. i was lacking words or maybe you weren't listening, either way i feel like it was unfair. as i previously told you, you are good peoples and i hope la gig worked out for you. you probably probably weren't expecting this message or maybe you were, but i just wanted to get it off my chest.  back when, way back when she wouldn't call you back or text you back, back when she only had an idea of how crazy you are, when you really weren't going to come to dc, but you did, again, and again, did you ever think it would come to this? ‪‭+1 (561) 866-3613‬‬
